prescriptions.remedy_label_human: Recite the Mars beej mantra 'Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namah' 108 times daily on Tuesday, facing east. Complete mahadasha-count japa over the dasha period.
Chant the Aditya Hridayam daily at sunrise, facing east, 108 times. This strengthens the Sun and brings favor from authority figures and government.
Recite the Moon beej mantra 'Om Shraam Shreem Shraum Sah Chandraya Namah' 108 times daily on Monday, facing east. Complete mahadasha-count japa over the dasha period.
Recite the Venus beej mantra 'Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namah' 108 times daily on Friday, facing east. Complete mahadasha-count japa over the dasha period.
Chant Shukra Ashtottara Shatanamavali 108 times on Fridays. Venus governs love, beauty, relationships, and luxury.

For Saturn-ruled chronic disease (bones, joints, nervous system; Saturn in 6H/8H or Sade Sati with health impact): perform Mahamrityunjaya japa to the prescribed count — 1,25,000 (1.25 lakh) for a ful
For afflicted Sun (combust, debilitated in Libra, or in 6/8/12): recite Aditya Hridayam (from Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda Ch.107) in full at sunrise facing east, daily during Sun dasha/antardasha.
